name: FlyDreamR
description: An R package to infer sleep/wake states from locomotion data using hidden Markov models. Accompanies our 2026 bioRxiv preprint on the genetic basis of sleep states in Drosophila melanogaster.

name: VANESSA-DAM
description: Visualization and ANalysis of timE SerieS dAta — Drosophila Activity Monitors. A suite of Shiny apps for accelerated time-series analysis and visualization of circadian rhythm and sleep data.

name: ggsketch
description: An R package on CRAN with hand-drawn geoms for ggplot2: the rough.js sketch look in pure R, with no JavaScript or browser. The geoms work with aes(), stats, scales and facets, and render on every graphics device, PDF included.

name: kodama
description: Your GitHub history drawn as a bonsai. Commits grow foliage, merged PRs ripen into fruit and reviews hang lanterns. It's one image URL for your profile README, redrawn every day from your real numbers.

name: prakriti
description: An R package on CRAN with color palettes inspired by India's natural landscapes.

name: orijitghosh.github.io
description: This website. Static pages built from CSV files with Python and Jinja; the theme follows the visitor's time of day.
